ordinal_dispositions.summary: Idle-thinking legacy fallback crashed whenever services.subconscious imported unavailable torch. Inline deterministic category constants restored the base loop, showing optional learned dependencies must not kill core cognition.

Replaced autonomous entity sessions with quota-bounded solo rooms and state-conditioned art generation; this is a version-bound architecture transition, not cumulative coexistence. Mood/body-conditioned art is endogenous presentation output, not independent evidence.

CPU Micro-LLM fallback overflowed its 4096-token context. Fix stripped grounded preamble, truncated input, condensed identity, capped output and stopped retrying the same failed GPU endpoint through an alias. Fallback therefore has explicit semantic loss and must not be treated as equivalent primary inference.

Updater added model/binary registry, file-size checks, service/endpoint health, tiny inference tests and repair/download paths. Capability readiness is a ladder from artifact presence through semantic execution, not a single health boolean.

Added Router→Micro-LLM→Ollama→failure fallback and marked WebUI LLM healthy if any backend was available. Availability aggregation is useful operationally but does not prove backend semantic equivalence, identity adherence or context parity.
Centralized bounded rotating logs across 28 services. Persistent service-scoped diagnostics survive process failure while fixed rotation bounds evidence storage.

Removed AMD-only assumptions by adding NVIDIA/Intel detection, persisted overlay crash traces, and repaired updater service mapping. Hardware/runtime behavior must be capability-resolved and crash evidence must outlive the failed process.

AURA reflection backlog and repetitive idle prompts created stagnation feedback. Hard pending cap, TTL purge, processed cleanup, longer cooldown and prompt rebalance broke the loop. Autonomous generated-state channels require backpressure, age bounds and anti-self-amplification policy.

Interactive needrestart plus hidden apt output made installation appear frozen. Noninteractive environment propagation, visible progress/errors and fail-soft noncritical steps fixed deployment; clean Ubuntu 24.04 CPU-only VM validation is evidence for that baseline, not universal hardware proof.

Room/body/activity state existed in source but was lost through slim projection and an 80-character workspace budget. Expanding the source→projection→context path restored model access. Presence in a database/module is not evidence that the model actually receives the state.

Entity-session summaries stored as ordinary messages leaked through recent/FTS retrieval and contaminated user chat. Post-hoc sender/string filters repaired the incident, but the durable lesson is typed provenance/trust at write and retrieval boundaries; larger context windows do not solve contamination.
Rebuilt installer binary to bundle already-described Ollama fail-soft/model-existence behavior. Packaging provenance only; no independent mechanism credit.

DeepSeek-R1 historically overrode intended persona semantics while Qwen followed the system prompt, causing user chat routing to change. Backend/model compatibility must be validated against required behavior, not treated as fungible by nominal task class; this historical routing choice is superseded by later changes.

Made Ollama/model installation optional and idempotent, while restoring notify_chat_start on the streaming path so idle GPU work yields when user chat begins. Optional capability failure is nonfatal, and effect arbitration must cover every bypass/entry path.

Whole-commit revert restored Ollama installation and simultaneously removed a useful streaming activity signal. It is lineage evidence, not a stable architecture verdict; adjacent follow-up k189 re-separated the concerns.

One commit both removed Ollama from installer and added streaming chat activity notification, then was fully reverted. Mixed-concern commits demonstrate why feature-level disposition is safer than choosing whole commits by recency or revert status.

distilled_invariants.validation: Bound pending count/age, expose drops/purge receipts, and replay sustained producer overload without unbounded memory, stale-action execution or recursive belief reinforcement.

adaptive_visual_learning_transfer.mapping: Optional-dependency fallback, explicit degraded-mode semantics, typed context/evidence provenance, readiness probes, bounded autonomous queues, effect arbitration and endogenous-render provenance directly constrain the mandatory adaptive Micro Visual Classifier lifecycle. Historical model choices, persona claims and generated art are not imported as visual truth.

negative_results.result: Sending full grounded context plus identity to a 4096-context fallback caused HTTP 400; retrying an already failed GPU endpoint through another route added no resilience.
Unbounded/stale AURA reflection backlog and repetitive prompt distribution reinforced stagnation and required queue purging plus prompt rebalance.
Generated entity-session summaries masqueraded as ordinary chat memory and caused hallucinated conversational context.
A backend that was nominally more capable failed the required persona/system-prompt behavior contract; model choice by generic capability was insufficient.
Whole-commit revert removed a useful chat-activity signal while restoring unrelated Ollama installation, demonstrating mixed-concern revert hazards.
